verdict.rationale: Statsig documents multiple ways to create/toggle flags programmatically — a Console API (CRUD), CLI (integratable into CI/CD), HTTP API, and an MCP server that lets AI tools like Claude Code/Cursor 'explore experiments and access Statsig data' — covering the create/toggle-via-API/CLI/MCP half of the story. However, there is no evidence of an approval-workflow or review-gate mechanism that would intercept or require sign-off before an agent's API/CLI/MCP write reaches production; access-management docs only cover SSO/SCIM for login, not change approval. Missing for 10: documented approval/review workflow gating agent-initiated flag changes, evidence that MCP server supports write/toggle operations (docs describe it as read/explore-oriented), and any audit-approval UI tying agent actions to human sign-off.
